0:
SELECT MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda'	----- bird -----	california_schools
1:
SELECT `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` LIKE '%Continuation%'
  AND `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
2:
SELECT Zip
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Fresno' 
  AND District = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND Charter = 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
3:
SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
4:
SELECT Phone
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = 1
AND FundingType = 'Directly funded'
AND OpenDate > '2000-01-01'	----- bird -----	california_schools
5:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400	----- bird -----	california_schools
6:
SELECT DISTINCT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 500 AND s.Magnet = 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
7:
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
8:
SELECT s.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
)	----- bird -----	california_schools
9:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 560
AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'	----- bird -----	california_schools
10:
SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
11:
SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` > 500
UNION
SELECT cds
FROM satscores
WHERE enroll12 > 500	----- bird -----	california_schools
12:
SELECT MAX(CAST(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL)) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE CDSCode IN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 
    AND CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr > 0.3
)	----- bird -----	california_schools
13:
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / CAST(sat.NumTstTakr AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
14:
SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5	----- bird -----	california_schools
15:
SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.dname = sc.District
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
16:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'merged Alameda' AND NumTstTakr < 100	----- bird -----	california_schools
17:
SELECT s.CharterNum, ss.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrWrite DESC	----- bird -----	california_schools
18:

FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cname = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.City = 'Fresno'
AND sc.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500

22:

FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC

23:
SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30	----- bird -----	california_schools
24:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm T1
INNER JOIN satscores T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 
AND T2.NumGE1500 >= 1	----- bird -----	california_schools
